did.description: The Ecosystem's DID (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.did`). Per VPR, several Ecosystem entries MAY share one DID — the primary key remains `id`. Identity only; trust state lives on the `Did` node.

corporationId.description: Stable `uint64` id of the Corporation that controls this Ecosystem (mirrors VPR `Ecosystem.corporation_id`).

lastObservedAtTime.description: ISO 8601 / RFC 3339 datetime string in UTC. MUST include the date, the time (with seconds), and the trailing `Z` UTC designator. Fractional seconds are OPTIONAL. Local times, non-UTC offsets, date-only values, and timezone-less times are NOT permitted.
lastObservedAtTime.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime

egf.description: Active Governance Framework (CGF on a Corporation, EGF on an Ecosystem). Mirrors the indexer-side `GovernanceFramework` shape.

activeSince.title: traverse_response_Iso8601DateTime
